svg.text: Subtyping Splits Into Two Strip Rules Whose Intersection Is Gcd(a, b)
Half-types: CommonDiv(12, 8) (no spills: Div(g) ⊆ CD) ∩ CommonMultOfCD(12, 8) (no empty sockets: CD ⊆ Div(g)) = Gcd(12, 8)
All Candidates g ∈ 0..12 Tested Against Sockets CD(12, 8) = {1, 2, 4}
Each row is Div(g); each column is d ∈ 0..12. Purple columns d ∈ {1, 2, 4} are the required sockets.
Subtyping Is Set Containment on the Value Number Line: Gcd(12, 8) ⊆ CommonDiv(12, 8) and Gcd(12, 8) ⊆ MultOfCD(12, 8)
Intersection Type: Gcd(12, 8) = { g │ Div(g) = CD }
